stem: Which sentence from the selection "A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt" supports the idea that Forrest Fenn sees his treasure as a way to inspire others?
instruction: Use "A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt" to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: He accumulated his treasure over a lifetime. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: He placed a 10-inch-by-10-inch bronze box of treasure somewhere in the Rocky Mountains between Santa Fe, New Mexico, and the Canadian border. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: He wanted to urge people to put down their electronic devices and go outside to appreciate nature. (paragraph 2)

options.label: D
options.text: Some travelers have even looked for the hidden treasure dozens of times, but none have found it yet. (paragraph 3)
